title: Goodness, Wisdom, and Power: One Triad at Three Discrete Degrees
description: A single triad of foundational principles — Goodness (Eudaimonia), Wisdom (Sophia), and Power — repeats itself at every discrete degree of being. What men in the world boast of as their well-being, wisdom, and strength are only the lowest reflections of a structure beginning in the Father of Greatness, descending through the cosmos of aeons (Spirit, mother of the Living Soul, angelic host), and reaching the elements (Perfect Man as Pillar of Glory, Living Spirit, Five Sons of the First Man).
